sites.enforcement_snippet:
if not EMAIL_REGEX.match(email):
    raise InvalidEmailFormatError(f"Malformed email address: {email}")

domain_notes: validate_user_email rejects any string that does not match the email regex, guarded by a single negated match. Both existing tests supply well-formed addresses (alice@example.com, bob@mail.company.org); neither supplies a malformed address, so the rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected validate_user_email because its regex match is the sole validation and no test supplies a malformed address.
